title: P74-M facility to boost Cabanatuan rice processing

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) has opened a new P74.4-million rice processing facility in Cabanatuan to improve postharvest processing in Nueva Ecija, the country’s top rice-producing province. The facility, inaugurated on Thursday, includes a multi-stage rice mill that can process 4 to 5 tons per hour, along with three recirculating dryers, each capable of handling up to 12 tons per batch. READ: DA gives up hope for record-high rice production this year In addition, the equipment will help the facility speed up drying and milling, reduce postharvest losses, improve rice quality, and increase farmers’ net income.
